# RankMint

> Data-driven rankings of unexpected topics. Interactive charts, tier lists, and narrative reports — all generated by AI agents.

## About

RankMint is an automated ranking content factory that produces data-driven rankings with interactive visualizations. Each ranking collects real data, scores items on weighted metrics, and generates narrative reports with interactive ECharts-based charts.

Website: https://rankmint.io
Author: Kiyeon Jeon

## Rankings

### Boss Fight Fairness Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/boss-fight-fairness-index/
Ranks 30 iconic video game boss fights by design honesty, not difficulty. Metrics: telegraph clarity, hitbox accuracy, recovery windows, camera behavior, learning curve design, retry friction.
- #1 Baldur (God of War 2018) — 8.73/10
- #2 Isshin (Sekiro) — 8.59/10
- #3 Genichiro (Sekiro) — 8.42/10
- Key finding: Malenia (Elden Ring) ranks A-tier for fairness despite being one of the hardest bosses. Bed of Chaos (Dark Souls) scored 1.50/10 — the least fair boss in gaming.

### Anime Sensei Competence Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/anime-sensei-competence-index/
Ranks 30 anime teachers/mentors by actual pedagogical effectiveness, not power level. Metrics: curriculum structure, student growth, individualized attention, safety record, motivational approach.
- #1 Koro-sensei (Assassination Classroom) — 9.70/10
- #2 Biscuit Krueger (Hunter x Hunter) — 8.74/10
- #3 Izumi Curtis (Fullmetal Alchemist) — 8.69/10
- Key finding: Kakashi Hatake scores C-tier (5.47) despite being one of the most beloved anime teachers. Gojo Satoru scores D-tier (3.20).

### K-Drama Binge Trap Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/kdrama-binge-trap-index/
Ranks 30 K-dramas by how structurally dangerous they are for your sleep schedule. Metrics: cliffhanger density, emotional hooks, episode pacing, "one more episode" factor.
- #1 Crash Landing on You — 7.60/10
- #2 Squid Game — 7.40/10
- #3 Penthouse — 7.10/10
- Key finding: Hospital Playlist ranks D-tier (3.15) — it's a slow burn, not a binge trap.

### Startup Graveyard Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/startup-graveyard-index/
Ranks 30 famous startup failures by how avoidable their death was. Metrics: market reality, product viability, ignored warnings, fraud vs honest failure.
- #1 Juicero — 8.25/10 (most avoidable death)
- #2 Lily Robotics — 8.10/10
- #3 Color Labs — 8.00/10
- Key finding: Vine scores D-tier (2.15) — its death was nearly unavoidable after Twitter acquired and deprioritized it. Theranos scored 7.95 (S-tier shame).

### City Ramen Value Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/city-ramen-value-index/
Ranks 30 cities worldwide by ramen value proposition. Metrics: affordability, shop density, quality, style variety, cultural depth.
- #1 Fukuoka — 9.21/10
- #2 Tokyo — 8.91/10
- #3 Osaka — 8.39/10
- Key finding: Fukuoka beats Tokyo due to superior cost-to-quality ratio. Seoul (#6) beats New York (#17). Portland (#11) is the best ramen city in the US.

### Disney Villain CEO Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/disney-villain-ceo-index/
Ranks 30 Disney/Pixar villains by corporate leadership fitness. Metrics: strategic vision, resource management, delegation, crisis handling, team retention, long-term planning, adaptability.
- #1 Hades (Hercules) — 86.9/100
- #2 Ursula (The Little Mermaid) — 80.8/100
- #3 King Candy (Wreck-It Ralph) — 70.9/100
- Key finding: Hades is Fortune 500 ready. Gaston scores 39.0 — peak middle management. Ursula outscores Scar as a CEO.

### Global Nap Culture Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/global-nap-culture-index/
Ranks 30 countries by how optimized they are for napping. Metrics: cultural acceptance, climate suitability, work schedule flexibility, public napping infrastructure.
- #1 Spain — 7.07/10
- #2 Netherlands — 6.96/10
- #3 Greece — 6.39/10
- Key finding: Spain invented the siesta but Netherlands nearly matches it with progressive work-life balance policies.

### Hangover Recovery Index
URL: https://rankmint.io/hangover-recovery-index/
Ranks 30 countries by how well they equip citizens to recover from a big night out. Metrics: pharmacy access, recovery food culture, cultural cure traditions, sleep-in tolerance.
- #1 Japan — 81.8/100
- #2 Finland — 79.0/100
- #3 France — 77.5/100
- Key finding: Japan turned hangover recovery into a billion-dollar science with dedicated recovery drinks and 24/7 convenience stores.
